sources.signal: DAMNIT agipd_saxs 0.3-0.5 nm^-1 / (xgm_intensity x total_transmission), run-triage D5
sources.off_band: 5.0 robust sigma of the run's own off class (§4.3)
sources.hit_cut: centre of the widest empty band of the block's pooled values relative to each run's off level, between the off band and the hits' mode (§4.4 on the relative axis)
sources.separation: hits need a mode >= 2.0 off bands above the off level
sources.static: more than 5.0 robust sigma below a running 0.75 quantile over 301 trains, residuals centred, iterated
